reason: The hypothesis synthesizes two separate bodies of literature—SRO effects on dislocation mobility in HfNbTaTiZr (P30) and edge-dislocation-controlled plateau strength in other RHEAs (P16, P13, P17, P5, P42)—into a single mechanistic chain that links SRO, lattice distortion, dislocation mechanism transition, thermal expansion, and elastic anisotropy. No single passage proposes this integrated causal pathway, and the specific prediction that SRO moderates thermal expansion and elastic anisotropy via a screw-to-edge transition is not stated in any source. The hypothesis thus combines findings from multiple papers into a new proposal that none of them suggests.
